name: Sanbo Hospital Management Group Limited
summary: Sanbo Hospital Management Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in hospital management in China. The company operates neurology and general hospitals. It is also involved in clinical medical; medical device management; medical investment; and property management services. It also offers neurosurgery services, including brain tumor surgery, cerebral vascular bypass surgery, functional neurosurgery for epilepsy and Parkinson's disease, spinal cord and nerve surgery, and pediatric neurosurgery; neurointervention; neuro-oncology chemotherapy and radiotherapy, including Gamma Knife and linear accelerator treatments; neurocritical care, and perioperative neurological monitoring.
